items.evidence: Log lines 2-129 dispense 5 uL Q5 2x mix into all 96 wells first, then 4 uL primer pair (e.g. lines 132-133) and 1 uL colony template last (lines 900-901), giving a 10 uL reaction at 1x.
Log shows primer_plate and colony_plate well X going to pcr_plate well X, e.g. A1->A1, B1->B1 ... H12->H12, for all 96 wells with no repeats or skips.
One tip is used for master mix into empty wells (lines 1-130), then a pick up and drop tip for every primer and every colony transfer; the log ends with a drop tip (line 1858).
Comments record sealing the plate and cycling at 98C 3 min, 30 x (98C 10 s, 60C 20 s, 72C 60 s), 72C 2 min, hold 4C, which suits Q5 Hot Start.
Follows the paper's 10 uL OT-2 workflow (mix first, 1 uL colony template last, seal then thermocycle then gel); the Q5 and in-well primer adaptation is sound and stated, and the citation is accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol sets up 96 10 uL reactions with 5 uL Q5 2x mix, 4 uL primer pair and 1 uL colony template, in that order. The run log shows correct A1-to-A1 mapping, fresh tips for every primer and colony, and a sensible Q5 thermocycling comment. All five items pass.
